_about: How the gallery is grouped and ordered (site/build.py build_gallery). examples/README.md (in the examples repository) stays the source of each card: its prompt, what it shows, its videos. This file only says which shelf a card sits on and in what order, so the site can be regrouped without a change to the examples repository. Every card belongs to exactly one group; the build stops when a card is in none or two, or when an id here has no card. Ids are the cards' ids: the number ("07") or the demo's name ("looks" for examples/_looks).

start_here.name: Start here
start_here.line: The three requests people make most: a launch video, a narrated explainer, and an edit of your own footage.
start_here._cards: Named by the kind of video, not the example's title; the card keeps the example's own request and details.

_groups: The shelves of the All view, in the docs' running order. Within a shelf, strongest first: the owner's call (today the 0.4 examples lead, then number order; Explainers follows the proposal's order). guides: [label, docs page, optional anchor], linked as "The guides behind these".

groups.name: Explainers
groups.line: Narrated explainers from a topic, a Wikipedia article, a PDF or a prize announcement; some stop and ask the viewer.

groups.name: Your footage
groups.line: Real recordings, edited: cards over a talking head, a long panel cut into clips, an interview tightened, a podcast as an audiogram.

groups.name: Products and brands
groups.line: Launch videos, promos, tutorials and brand motion, from a landing page, a running app, a repo or a Claude Design export.

groups.name: Code and data
groups.line: Charts that move, and videos made from a release or a pull request.

groups.name: Social and trailers
groups.line: Vertical shorts, montages cut on the beat, trailers and a travel slideshow.

groups.name: Looks and motion
groups.line: Look signatures, WebGL looks, the shutter blur and the showreel template: what a video looks like before it says a word.

new.name: New in 0.4
new._name: The badge on the cards, the last tab and the landing's tile: all of 0.4.x.

_see_it_done: Example ids under a docs page's lede ("See it done: ..."), by page. Seeded from the docs map's Choose your path cards; voice from the proposal.
